name: AsiaInfo Xinwei TDA Connector
description: Read-only connector package for AsiaInfo Security Xinwei TDA. It syncs TDA asset and alert data through the existing signed device tool registry.

release.notes: Adds read-only AsiaInfo TDA 2025.6 signed asset and alert sync through the device tool registry.
changelog: Uses asiainfo_tda_health for customer-visible signed connector testing.
Uses asiainfo_tda_alerts for realtime alert ingestion.
Keeps device targeting configurable through FLOCKS_CONNECTOR_DEVICE_ID.
Normalizes TDA alert list address and timestamp fields for local Alert ingestion.
